subject: an English scholar of the late 1600s with long wavy shoulder-length brown hair, a thin face and intense thoughtful eyes, wearing a dark plain coat with a white linen collar

panels.01-woolsthorpe: a small grey stone farmhouse in the Lincolnshire countryside on a frosty winter night in 1642, candle light in one window, an apple orchard bare of leaves, sheep in the field, stars, wide establishing shot
panels.02-grantham: a twelve-year-old English schoolboy in 1650s clothes in a small attic room in Grantham, building a wooden model windmill with tools, walls covered in charcoal drawings of birds, ships and geometric figures
panels.03-prism: {S} as a young man in a darkened farmhouse room at Woolsthorpe in 1666, a single beam of sunlight through a hole in the shutter passing through a glass prism and spreading into a band of colours on the wall, wonder and focus
panels.04-telescope: {S} at a workbench in a Cambridge college room in 1668, polishing a small metal mirror, a short tube telescope beside him, tools and notes, candlelight
panels.05-halley: {S} in conversation with a younger English astronomer in a periwig in a Cambridge college study in 1684, papers with orbit diagrams spread on the table, books stacked high
panels.06-principia: {S} holding a freshly printed large book at a London print shop in 1687, printers at a wooden hand press behind him, stacks of printed sheets, a quiet proud moment
panels.07-mint: {S} older, wearing a grey periwig and dark coat, inspecting silver coins at a table in the Royal Mint in the Tower of London in 1696, workers at coin presses behind him, lantern light
panels.08-abbey: the great Gothic nave of Westminster Abbey in 1727, a solemn funeral procession of gentlemen in black carrying a coffin under a pall, candles, stone arches, dignified and quiet
